newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers fall on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers fall on weak demand.

text.p: Cash basis offers for U.S. soymeal were down in several markets due to light demand and to dealers trying to compensate for the CBOT August's premium to the September contract, dealers said.
Cash soymeal sales were slow largely because buyers resisted the high price of August soymeal versus new-crop soymeal. New-crop soymeal should be available late next month.

Several soybean crushing plants were shut down this week for maintenance. Dealers said the tight supply of soybeans now and the start of harvest late next month makes August a good time to perform routine maintenance.
